summary: Kartoon Studios filed an 8-K on July 17, 2026, announcing the sale of its interest in Federator Networks, Inc., which operated the Federator Channel network business, for $500,000 in cash. The company retains key Frederator Studios IP such as Bee and PuppyCat and Bravest Warriors for licensing. The board recommended the transaction as part of a strategic realignment toward IP monetization. No advisor named. The deal is an all-cash sale with no disclosed premium or timeline. Watch for completion risk and the company's execution of its IP-focused strategy.
